topics.title: Basic Hygiene

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of some steps in the handwashing routine.
Practice health habits that prevent infectious diseases and infestations (such as lice) when appropriate, with adult support, instruction, and modeling.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of more steps in the handwashing routine.
Begin to independently practice health habits that prevent infectious disease and infestations (such as lice) when appropriate, with less adult support, instruction, and modeling.

topics.title: Oral Health

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of some steps of the routine for brushing teeth, with adult supervision and instruction.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Demonstrate knowledge of more steps of the routine for brushing and when toothbrushing should be done, with less adult supervision.

topics.title: Knowledge of Wellness

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Identify a few internal body parts (most commonly the bones, brain, and heart) but may not understand their basic function.
Begin to understand that health- care providers try to keep people well and help them when they are not well.
Communicate to an adult about not feeling well, feeling uncomfortable, or about a special health need, with varying speci city and reliability.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Identify several different internal body parts and demonstrate a basic, limited knowledge of some functions.
Demonstrate greater understanding that health-care providers try to keep people well and help them when they are not well.
Communicate to an adult about not feeling well, feeling uncomfortable, or about a special health need, with more speci city and reliability.

topics.title: Sun Safety

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Begin to practice sun-safe actions, with adult support and guidance.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Practice sun-safe actions with de- creasing adult support and guidance.

topics.title: Injury Prevention

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Follow safety rules with adult support and prompting.
Begin to show ability to follow emergency routines after instruction and practice (for example, a re drill or earthquake drill).
Show beginning ability to follow transportation and pedestrian safety rules with adult instruction and supervision.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Follow safety rules more independently though may still need adult support and prompting.
Demonstrate increased ability to follow emergency routines after instruction and practice.
Show increased ability to follow transportation and pedestrian safety rules with adult support and supervision.

topics.title: Nutrition Knowledge

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Identify different kinds of foods.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Identify a larger variety of foods and may know some of the related food groups.

topics.title: Nutrition Choices

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Demonstrate a beginning understand- ing that eating a variety of food helps the body grow and be healthy, and choose from a variety of foods at mealtimes.
Indicate food preferences that re ect familial and cultural practices.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Demonstrate greater understanding that eating a variety of food helps the body grow and be healthy, and choose from a greater variety of foods at mealtimes.
Indicate food preferences based on familial and cultural practices and on some knowledge of healthy choices.

topics.title: Self-Regulation of Eating

subtopics.title: At around 48 months of age:

outcomes.text: Indicate awareness of own hunger and fullness.

subtopics.title: At around 60 months of age:

outcomes.text: Indicate greater awareness of own hunger and fullness.
